_meta.notes: The planetary climate field that drives weather: advected humidity and cloud, orographic lift over terrain, temperature by season, hour and altitude, and rare thunderstorm cells. See packages/weather/src/climateField.ts.

seed.notes: Field seed. The same seed reproduces the same climate on every server.

system_scale_m.notes: Size of one weather system in metres. Smaller means more local variety.

wind_speed_mps.notes: Prevailing wind speed. Advects the field and drives orographic lift.

orographic_distance_m.notes: Distance over which the upslope is measured for orographic lift.

orographic_lift.notes: Humidity gained per metre per second of upslope. Windward slopes cloud over first.

temperature_base_c.notes: Mean temperature at sea level, mid-season.

temperature_noise_c.notes: Local temperature variation that follows the humidity noise.

altitude_lapse_c_per_m.notes: Temperature lost per metre of altitude. The standard atmosphere is 0.0065.

humidity_base.notes: Mean relative humidity of the field.

humidity_swing.notes: Half the humidity range the noise may add.

cloud_threshold.notes: Humidity at which cloud begins; full cloud at 1.

precipitation_threshold.notes: Cloud cover at which rain or snow begins.

snow_threshold_c.notes: Below this temperature precipitation falls as snow.

storm_cloud_threshold.notes: Cloud cover above which a cell may storm.

storm_chance.notes: Share of eligible cells that storm. Small numbers make storms rare events.

reevaluate_s.notes: How often the state machine asks the field again while a field-chosen state holds.

storm_cooldown_s.notes: Seconds of calm after a storm, so one passing cell cannot loop its thunder.

precipitation_start.notes: Precipitation needed to begin raining from clear weather (hysteresis).
